extends: v1.1 (OJ=ColdGrip only; remains authoritative for the single-instrument G1)
purpose: Multi-instrument expansion (S1) to reach a defensible N by pooling events across instruments. Bottleneck is N, not model sophistication.

pooling.rationale: prevents any single instrument from dominating the pooled Sharpe estimate

features_source: noaa-gfs-bdp-pds archive (as-published, no lookahead). ERA5 reanalysis permitted ONLY for target validation, never as an input feature.

DroughtGrip.theta_spi: median SPI over train-window drought rows (deterministic, per-fold)

StormGrip.theta_h: median of train-fold hurricane_prob distribution (empirical, per-fold, not hardcoded)

HeatGrip.theta_cdd: median of train-fold cdd_3day distribution (empirical, per-fold, not hardcoded)

trade.entry: first trading-session close ON/AFTER cycle date

metric.type: event-based trade-level net-of-benchmark Sharpe, pooled across ALL instruments and folds, equal-weight per event

decision_rules.PASS: N_pooled>=30 and net-of-benchmark Sharpe>1.0 and bootstrap CI lower>0
decision_rules.FAIL_PIVOT: N_pooled>=30 and (CI includes 0 or mean net<=0)
decision_rules.KILL_PIVOT: N_pooled>=30 and net-of-benchmark Sharpe<0 -> confirmed null -> cat-bond/reinsurance pivot

hard_gates.roll_jump_armor: roll-date move >5x daily sigma without modeled weather event -> halt
hard_gates.cross_instrument_leakage: no instrument may use another instrument's market returns

deliverables: Contract V2 structure drafted (this document + pakhi/ws1/instruments.py)
Instrument & signal-class registry (empirical-median mechanisms, no hardcoded thresholds)
Market-data downloader scripts/refresh_market.py (Yahoo OJ/Corn/NG/Wheat; ERCOT pending ercot_settlement feed)
Continuous-series rebuild across all Yahoo instruments
Pooled event-level harness across instruments AND folds
N_pooled >= 30 check; under-powered -> continue paper accumulation

LOCK.gate: CEO + CTO hash after 1A-1D verified clean of lookahead on historical folds
LOCK.trigger: flip status DRAFT -> LOCKED and set payload_sha256

change_control: v2.0 draft -> lock (CEO + CTO hash). Amendments require v2.(n+1).
